slides.title: Things that count as cleaning (even if your brain says they don't)
Small wins add up
slides.body: Six tiny tasks in a day is real progress. It doesn't have to look dramatic.

slides.title: Prep counts too
slides.body: Putting a bin by the couch so tomorrow is easier? That's cleaning.

slides.title: Deciding counts
slides.body: Choosing to donate the bread maker is the hard part. Hauling it is the easy bit.

slides.title: Rest after counts
slides.body: Stopping before burnout keeps you going tomorrow. That's part of the system.

slides.title: If it made your home a little easier to live in, it counts.
Want a reset that counts the small stuff?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.

What tiny thing did you do today that counts?
